360	Today the Treasury Ministry has coffee and clerks, so what was in the Treasury Ministry?	Hoje o ministério da Fazenda tem café e funcionários, então o que havia no ministério da Fazenda?

362	It was a fortress with hall after hall inside, soldiers, guards, corridors, and in the middle there is	Era uma fortaleza com salão após salão, soldados, guardas, corredores, e no meio há

364	all the jewelry of the kings and queens of earlier generations that was kept there, their crowns,	todas as joias dos reis e rainhas das gerações anteriores que estavam ali, as suas coroas,
